name: qa-bike-knockoff
note: P1 10-08, PO verbatim: "I was driving on the bike in L1 and when I was attacked by a zombie the bike just disappeared...". Rides the D-GROVE street at z = -16 at full speed into an infected; no clear pavement lies within 8 m of the bump, so the old dismount fell back to the last parking spot and the bike jumped back to where she had mounted it. Now: she is knocked off (short stumble), the bike tips over beside her and lies on the drawn road; she clears the infected with the bat, picks the bike up (E) and rides on. Gates: the bike is drawn at its sim spot every frame it is in view, no tyre below the drawn road.
